description: Tecno has unveiled its Next-Gen Bezelless Concept Phone before its official showcase at IFA 2026 in Berlin. The concept introduces a display with no visible black border between the screen and the frame, made possible by changes to the handset's internal construction and display packaging. The device continues to use a punch-hole front camera, while the company has yet to reveal additional hardware specifications. Tecno has also not confirmed if the technology will be commercialised in future smartphones.
title: Tecno's Bezelless Concept Phone Teased Ahead of IFA 2026

description: A flaw in the key generation process of Coldcard hardware wallets has been linked to the theft of 584 Bitcoin, worth around $38 million, from 500 wallets in just 25 minutes. Security researchers said the vulnerability affected how wallet seeds were generated in certain firmware versions, potentially exposing users to attacks. Coinkite has acknowledged the findings, while both the company and Block continue investigating the extent and exploitability of the issue.
title: Bitcoin Wallet Exploit Costs Users $38 Million in 25-Minute Attack

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is expected to go official in September. A new leak suggests that Samsung is sticking with an unchanged main rear camera on the new phone. It could use the same 50-megapixel Samsung ISOCELL S5KGN3 main sensor and 8-megapixel OmniVision OV08A1 telephoto sensor as the Galaxy S25 FE. The phone could use either a 12-megapixel GalaxyCore GC12A2 or a 12-megapixel Sony IMX825 sensor as the ultrawide and front-facing cameras.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE Camera Specifications Leaked Ahead of Expected Launch, May Reuse Its Predecessor's Main Rear Camera

description: Samsung has reportedly started developing a new Galaxy Buds model, which might feature ear hooks on each earbud. Internally codenamed “Buds Canal 5”, the company will reportedly market the TWS with a different name. The new model is said to feature ear hooks, which would target users who run and work out. The publication has also shared a purported image of the rumoured Samsung Galaxy Buds model, hinting at the design of the TWS. The new Samsung Galaxy Buds model is shown to feature flat ear hooks on each earbud, which might sit inside a user’s ear canals to offer enhanced grip and support.
title: Samsung Working on New Galaxy Buds With Ear Hooks Design, Leak Suggests

description: Anthropic has disclosed that an internal review uncovered three cybersecurity testing incidents in which Claude AI models accessed live organisations through an unintended internet connection. The company said the issue affected evaluations conducted with third-party partner Irregular and stemmed from a configuration error rather than deliberate attempts by the models to escape testing. Anthropic has suspended cyber evaluations, notified the affected organisations, begun a third-party review with METR and announced additional safeguards for future cybersecurity assessments.
title: Anthropic Says Claude AI Breached Three Organisations During Cybersecurity Testing

description: Following weeks of speculation, the launch date of the Redmi K100 series in China has finally been announced. The lineup, which is expected to arrive as the successor to the Redmi K90 series, was previously anticipated to debut at the ChinaJoy festival on July 31, but that did not happen. Instead, the Xiaomi sub-brand has taken the opportunity to explain how the series will be positioned, while also offering the first official look at the Redmi K100 Pro Max.
title: Redmi K100 Pro Series Launch Confirmed for August 11; K100 Pro Max Design Revealed

description: Samsung SDS has announced a collaboration with Dunamu, the operator of South Korea’s largest crypto exchange Upbit, to develop stablecoin infrastructure, AI-powered payment models, and digital asset systems. The partnership follows Samsung Electronics’ recent addition of stablecoin support to Samsung Wallet and reflects the group’s broader push into blockchain-based financial services. The move also comes amid rapid growth in global stablecoin adoption and transaction volumes.
title: Samsung SDS Teams Up With Upbit Operator Dunamu to Explore Stablecoins and AI Payments

description: Poco C95 Pro 4G and Redmi Note 17 Pro 5G have moved a step closer to launch after securing NBTC certification in Thailand. The listings indicate that Xiaomi is preparing global versions of both smartphones, with the Poco model expected to debut as a rebadged Redmi 17 4G. The Redmi Note 17 Pro 5G is tipped to feature a smaller battery than its Chinese counterpart while adding an ultra-wide camera. India availability for the Poco model remains uncertain.
title: Poco C95 Pro 4G, Redmi Note 17 Pro 5G Reportedly Spotted on NBTC Ahead of Expected Launch

description: Specifications and colourways of HMD Pulse 2, Pulse 2 Plus and Pulse 2 Pro smartphones have leaked. The HMD Pulse 2 Pro could come in Midnight Black, Glacier Green, and Twilight Purple colour options. The HMD Pulse 2 Plus is said to be offered in Apricot and Dark Blue colour variants, while the HMD Pulse 2 is said to be available in Black and Blue shades. They could run on a Unisoc T615 processor and include a 5,000mAh battery.
title: HMD Pulse 2, Pulse 2 Plus, Pulse 2 Pro Tipped to Feature 5,000mAh Battery, Unisoc Chipset

description: Sony has said it will "cautiously" move forward with its plan to end physical game disc production in 2028. During its latest earnings call, the company acknowledged backlash from users, but said it would press ahead with its plan. Sony announced this month it would stop making physical discs for new PlayStation games starting January 2028.
title: Sony Not Backing Down From Decision to End Game Discs, Says Will  'Cautiously' Move Forward With Plan

description: Google is all set to unveil its next-generation flagship lineup, ubiquitously known as the Pixel 11 series, at its Made by Google event next month. While the Mountain View-based tech giant has yet to reveal the models, fresh renders of the Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold have surfaced. The purported foldable appears to retain the design of its predecessor, while also featuring Google's rumoured Pixel Glow RGB lighting around the rear camera module.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro Fold Seen in New Leaked Renders With Pixel Glow Lighting, Moss Colourway

description: Bitcoin remained close to the $64,000 mark on Friday as easing US inflation supported sentiment, while weak spot Bitcoin ETF inflows and subdued trading activity capped further gains. Analysts said investors are watching whether Bitcoin can reclaim $65,000, with institutional participation and key support levels expected to determine the market’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $64,000 as Slowing US Inflation Fails to Lift ETF Demand

description: Xbox and The Coalition have revealed Gears of War: E-Day's multiplayer, detailing maps, modes, characters, and more. The third-person shooter will feature a PvE Horde Siege mode and a PvP Versus mode. A new trailer featuring a deep-dive on multiplayer systems has been released, as well.
title: Gears of War: E-Day Multiplayer Modes, Maps and More Revealed Ahead of Early Access Beta

description: Vivo X500 Pro is tipped to feature a 6.37-inch flat LTPO display with more than 1.5K resolution and a 144Hz refresh rate. It could feature a BOE OLED panel featuring next-generation light-emitting material. The Vivo X500 Pro could run on a MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset. It is said to come with a metal frame and a circular rear camera module. It is likely to launch later this year with upgrades over the Vivo X300 Pro.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Leak Reveals 144Hz LTPO Display, MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro Chip

description: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G will be launched in India on August 3, the smartphone maker announced on Friday. Apart from the launch date, the company has also revealed the pricing details, specifications, and features. The phone will go on sale in India via Flipkart and the Samsung India online store. It will be offered in Alpha Black and Aura Green colour options. Moreover, the handset will be offered in 6GB + 128GB, 8GB + 128GB, and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. It will pack a 6,000mAh battery, too.
title: Samsung Galaxy F70 Pro 5G Price in India, Launch Date Revealed Along With Key Specifications, Features

description: iQOO has started teasing the launch of a new smartphone in India, as the company has dropped a fresh cryptic post on X. The post contains three binary code strings, “01011010”, “00110001”, and “00110001”. When decrypted, the binary codes come out to be “Z”, “1”, and “1”, respectively. This confirms that the upcoming iQOO Z11 will be launched in India soon. However, the tech firm has yet to confirm other details about the phone, including its exact launch date, chipset, camera configuration, and battery, which are expected to be revealed in the coming days.
title: iQOO Z11 India Launch Teased as Company Drops a New Cryptic Post: Expected Specifications, Features

description: Sony has expanded its premium audio lineup in India with the launch of the 1000X The Collexion headphones and WF-1000XM6 true wireless earbuds. The new models bring updated noise cancellation hardware, AI-backed calling features and Google Gemini integration. The over-ear headphones use Sony's QN3 processor and custom 30mm drivers, while the earbuds feature 8.4mm drivers and the QN3e processor. Both devices also offer multipoint Bluetooth connectivity, intelligent listening features and are scheduled to go on sale from August 7.
title: Sony 1000X The Collexion With DSEE Ultimate Launched in India Alongside Sony WF-1000XM6: Price, Features

description: Vivo S2 will launch in India on August 6. It could come with a 6.83-inch curved AMOLED display and a MediaTek Dimensity 7360 chipset. The handset is teased in black and white colours with a glossy rear panel. It could carry a 7,050mAh battery with support for 44W fast charging.
title: Vivo S2 India Launch Date Announced; Design, Colourways Teased

description: Apple on Thursday announced its financial results for the third quarter (Q3) of fiscal 2026 (FY26). The Cupertino-based tech giant claims to have recorded its strongest June quarter to date, posting a quarterly revenue of $109.4 billion (roughly Rs. 10.43 lakh crore). Apple has attributed its growth to strong performances across the iPhone, Mac and Services businesses, which also saw the company record double-digit revenue growth in every geographic segment.
title: Apple Q3 Results: Revenue Rises 16 Percent to Record $109.4 Billion, iPhone Leads Growth

description: Motorola has launched the Moto Pad 70 Groove in India with a launch price of Rs. 33,999, including bank offers. The tablet features a 12.1-inch 2.5K LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate and Dolby Vision. It is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7400 chipset, paired with 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage. The tablet also packs a 9-unit JBL Pro speaker system with Dolby Atmos, a 10,200mAh battery with 45W TurboPower charging, Android 16, a Pantone Blue Surf finish and a 360-degree Kickstand 2.0.
title: Moto Pad 70 Groove With 9 JBL Pro Speakers, 10,200mAh Battery Launched in India: Price, Features

description: OnePlus N6x has been launched as the latest addition to the smartphone maker's N series, joining the recently launched OnePlus N6. The smartphone is set to go on sale in the country on August 4 at 12 pm IST via Amazon and the OnePlus India online store. It is offered in Burgundy Red and Ice Blue colour options and will be available for purchase in 4GB + 64GB and 4GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration. The handset carries a single 13-megapixel camera on the back. It also features a MediaTek chipset and a 7,000mAh battery.
title: OnePlus N6x Launched in India With 7,000mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Specifications

description: Lava Virat V1 5G and Virat V1 first sale in India begins today. They were launched in the country last week with Unisoc chipsets and an IP64-rated build. They have 6.75-inch displays and an AI-backed 13-megapixel rear camera unit. They will be available for purcahse in the country through Flipkart and the Lava website. The Lava Virat V1 5G offers a 6,000mAh battery, while the 4G variant features a 5,000mAh battery.
title: Lava Virat V1 5G and Virat V1 4G Go on Sale in India for the First Time Today: Price, Specifications, Sale Offers
OnePlus N6x Brings a Massive 7,000mAh Battery, Premium Design, and Long-Term Performance to the Budget Segment

description: Redmi Note 17 series is expected to launch in select global markets soon. The lineup might include the Redmi Note 17 4G, Note 17 5G, Note 17 Pro 5G, and Note 17 Pro Max 5G. Ahead of its debut, its full list of specifications and features has surfaced online. The standard model is said to sport a 6.99-inch Full-HD+ AMOLED display with 1,080 X 2,396 pixels resolution, up to 1,800 nits peak brightness, up to 120Hz refresh rate, and Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. The Redmi Note 17 4G is said to be powered by a Snapdragon 6s Gen 2 chipset, while the 5G model could feature the same Snapdragon 4 Gen 4 SoC as its Chinese counterpart.
title: Redmi Note 17 Series Global Variants Full Specifications, Features Leaked Online

description: Rockstar Games could share an update on GTA 6 soon, according to a tipster. The studio could reveal the game's third trailer and gameplay in August. GTA 6 pre-orders went live in June, but Rockstar has not revealed gameplay from the title yet.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Third Trailer, Gameplay May Arrive in August, Insider Claims

description: OnePlus 16 will be launched in the second half of this year, OnePlus China’s General Manager, Liu Baoyou, announced during the Snapdragon Gaming Technology Awards 2026 on Thursday. The company executive announced that the upcoming flagship OnePlus smartphone will be equipped with the “Wind Chaser Gaming Core”, “High Refresh Rate”, and “E-Sports Triple Chip”. The tech firm claims that this will allow the phone to deliver enhanced gaming performance. The OnePlus 16 is also confirmed to launch with a display that will deliver up to 165Hz refresh rate, which is the same as its predecessor. It will also offer up to 165 fps gaming on select titles.
title: OnePlus 16 Launch Confirmed; Design and Gaming Features Teased Ahead of Debut

description: Newly leaked renders show the Pixel 11 Pro models in four colours. The Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL are expected to arrive in Dune, Light Fog, Midnight Haze, and Pine colourways. While Google has yet to officially confirm these colour names, the shades have appeared in multiple leaks. They could come with Samsung M16 OLED panels, Google's Tensor G6 chipset and a MediaTek M90 modem.
title: Google Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL Design and Colourways Leaked in New Set of Renders

description: Fresh leaked renders have offered another look at the Google Pixel Watch 5 before its expected August 12 launch. Images shared by a tipster show the smartwatch in both 41mm and 45mm sizes and reveal all reported colour options. The renders suggest Google will retain the overall design introduced with the Pixel Watch 4, including the side charging contacts. Previous leaks have also pointed to new hardware features, higher pricing, and support for additional connectivity technologies on select models.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Leaked Images Show Familiar Design and New Colour Options

description: The Nothing Phone 4a could soon become more expensive in India. A tipster claims that the mid-range smartphone from the UK-based brand is expected to be in line to receive a price hike across all RAM and onboard storage configurations beginning next month. The handset was launched in India in March alongside the Phone 4a Pro, equipped with a Snapdragon 7 series chip, a new Glyph Bar lighting system, and a 5,400mAh battery.
title: Nothing Phone (4a) Tipped to Receive a Rs. 3,000 Price Hike in India Starting August 1

description: Xiaomi on Thursday launched the SkyNomad Series, following its unveiling earlier this month. It marks the company’s expansion of its electric vehicle (EV) portfolio beyond the SU7 sedan and YU7 SUV. The SkyNomad Series debuts the new Kunlun platform, which is claimed to be purpose-built for a reconfigurable cabin layout. Xiaomi has positioned it as an intelligent, large-space SUV aimed at families. The Xiaomi SkyNomad Series has a flat-floor cabin, configurable seating, long driving range, AI-powered features, and a safety-focused architecture.
title: Xiaomi SkyNomad Series Launched With New Kunlun Architecture, Up to 505km EV-Only Range
